arguments.literal: source-owned method law
bounded operation is activated

include current subject and known material dependencies; a rule packet without its subject, an inaccessible digest or an unsupported stale summary is insufficient; partial projection, sparse checkout and an empty record prove no authoritative absence; acquire the owner or retain indeterminacy; exclude irrelevant content unless needed to establish irrelevance; decomposition cannot drop material outer obligations to meet capacity
source-owned method law
any fixed or adaptive allocation or reconfiguration is selected

every allocation preserves material dependencies, outstanding obligations, observed and uncertain effects, admitted authority and required independence; functional, communication, authority and evaluation dependencies are distinct; no unique topology follows from capacity; an optimality claim states objective, constraints, comparison scope and evidence
source-owned method law
an obligation is excluded as not applicable
unknown applicability or missing evaluation is not false applicability
source-owned method law
a contribution is used to discharge an obligation
unauthenticated evidence discharges nothing; missing planned judgment and uncovered responsibility outside a plan are different
source-owned method law
composite subject or governing basis cannot be interpreted

declare once whether each relation is an admission condition or required material join; failed admission prevents interpretation while a false join falsifies an admitted conjunction; retain component failure without falsely assigning the invalid aggregate scope
source-owned method law
results are regrouped or operations reordered

conjunction precedence and the normalized effect join are associative only on that fixed domain; arbitrary operators need their own demonstrated law preserving the outer predicate; reordering needs effect independence; invalid intermediate joins defeat the rewrite; UP-016/017 and AC-016 own sequential composition; an unestablished outer interpretation or join yields the applicable unresolved or invalid_basis result, never guessed success
source-owned method law
composite predicate/basis is interpretable and a required applicable predicate or material join is authentically falsified
an invalid contribution cannot erase an independently authenticated failure
source-owned method law
interpretable composite has no authenticated applicable falsification

the combining evaluation is performed when applied without changing component performance; satisfaction needs established applicable coverage, authenticated results and every material join; an empty list requires proof the required set is empty

private context is discarded or process resumes
private context loss creates no authority or idempotence guarantee; full-history replay is not universal; sufficient surviving sources can support resumption without every activation transcript
additional domain policy
the consumer adopts and lawfully activates the optional task-based Executive arrangement
this is additional profile policy, not core topology or authority; configuration preservation applies to every arrangement independently of this optional Executive
source-owned method law
an effect is relevant to the operation

the boundary includes every materially possible part under the supported operating model and every observed departure, requested or unintended; an empty log or discarded context proves no absence; not_requested requires established effect-free scope; observed unrequested nonstart contributes not_requested while requested nonstart is not_started; reverted requires at least one begun part and every begun part reversed; partial requires a completed part and known unexecuted or reverted remainder; any unknown material remainder stays unknown; retain irreversible external effects and every observation

source-owned method law
material state may change between observation and effect
reobserve, compare revision or use protected snapshot as bound by the operation; no universal isolation implementation
source-owned method law
required checking and acceptance are allocated
fresh context and role names do not establish independent authorship or authority
source-owned method law
performance of the named evaluation is reported

retain observed extent, interruption and conclusion separately; an absent return establishes neither nonperformance nor an inconclusive evaluation; missing judgments remain coverage slots; a precondition is evidence unless separately required by the plan; an admission predicate cannot silently replace the downstream predicate
source-owned method law
A-to-Z work is decomposed into bounded transitions
purpose, identity, compatibility and assurance are extra premises; finite capacity does not derive them
source-owned method law
a core result is projected or consumed

possible enum pairs are not automatic admissibility; performance describes what evidence establishes, not an unobserved world fact; preserve extent, interruption, conclusion and all effect coordinates
source-owned method law
candidate_ready or an acceptance/yield decision is reported
availability is not fitness; lawful yield is not product completion; decision recording is not a grant

source-owned method law
progress or completion is claimed

counts are not a distance metric; Intent, Product and Specification refine Z under their owning authority; changing Z follows that owner and proves no old-destination completion; failed retry requires a supported causal change
source-owned method law
domain outcome is reported

missing required reason gives indeterminate and inadmissible deciding support while retaining raw outcome and unresolved authentication; separately admissible counterevidence or basis/scope diagnosis still applies on that predicate; preserve unconfirmed performance; no refinement upgrades failure, undecidability, nonperformance or unknown effects into greater standing; preserve the domain owner and original predicate; new predicates do not overwrite earlier results
source-owned method law
a result is reported

every result projection preserves these coordinates and the original predicate; references preserve meaning and availability; no mandatory serialization or extra work carrier; a new result over a different predicate never overwrites the earlier result
source-owned method law
a stored result is reused
preserve demonstrably independent work; widen inspection when independence is unproved; stored green status alone is not validity
source-owned method law
an operation with uncertain effects may be repeated
partial persistent progress implies no universal idempotence; logs have only their declared domain role
source-owned method law
any admitted control state is encountered
repair, re-entry, refusal, yield or termination stays within the actual grant; total control promises neither external termination, omniscience nor a solution to every world problem
source-owned method law
predicate is evaluated
the value is relative to this predicate; equal spelling across domains is not equal meaning
source-owned method law
admissible contrary current observations challenge retained beliefs
observations do not silently replace a frozen basis or rewrite governing requirements; reality and intended constraints remain distinct
